title: sigil-listening-tts/1
description: The manifest of a blind TTS listening test (make_tts_test.py writes it into test/manifest.json and test/manifest.js; tts-listen.html reads it). mode `mushra`: every trial plays the same prompt by several systems (numbered 1..N in a per-trial random order) and the listener rates each 0-100 (MUSHRA-lite: no hidden reference or anchor, every sample must be played before it can be rated). mode `pairwise`: two renditions, A / B / no preference. Audio paths are relative to the page; systems are named only in key.json.

labels.description: Equally spaced anchors from min to max (Bad, Poor, Fair, Good, Excellent).

text.description: The prompt, shown so listeners can judge pronunciation.

stimuli.description: mushra: the renditions in display order.
